metadata.title: Microsoft to raise up to $25 billion in bond market as investors get pickier about AI debt binge - MarketWatch

content.text:
Market Extra
Microsoft to raise up to $25 billion in bond market as investors get pickier about AI debt binge
What’s changed since the summer is which companies investors want to back in the AI race — and at what level
The big artificial-intelligence borrowing binge is back on.
Microsoft MSFT hit the market with the first highly rated “hyperscaler” bond deal since August, featuring 10 tranches of debt that would mature in two to 40 years, according to data from Informa Global Markets.
